_comment: Vocabulary for parsing Amazon Bedrock usage types (CUR line_item_usage_type / price list 'usagetype') and CloudWatch ModelId values onto one canonical model name. Usage types: the region prefix ('USE1-') is dropped, the rest is lowercased, 'phrase_rewrites' run on the whole string, then it is split into tokens on anything but letters, digits and dots. The model is the longest run of tokens whose compact form (letters and digits only) is a model name or alias below; it may be preceded only by 'skip_leading_tokens' or rule tokens. Direction / deployment rules are then tried in order on the remaining tokens; the first whose 'all' tokens are all present wins. ModelIds (and ARNs ending in one) go through 'model_id_rewrites' (geo prefix, date and version dropped) and the same alias table, so 'us.anthropic.claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219-v1:0' and 'USE1-Claude3.7Sonnet-input-tokens' both become 'claude-3-7-sonnet'.
_unverified: Assumption (spike-aws): only the six demo usage types (Claude3.7Sonnet / Claude3.5Haiku / NovaPro x input-tokens / output-tokens, with or without 'USE1-') are taken as given. Every other spelling here (Claude 3 / 3.5 v2 / 4.x names in both 'Claude4Sonnet' and 'ClaudeSonnet4' order, Nova / Titan / Llama / Mistral / Cohere / DeepSeek / AI21 / OpenAI / Writer / Qwen usage types, cache-read / cache-write, batch, long-context, latency-optimized, priority / flex tiers, cross-region, provisioned throughput model-unit usage types, price list units) is inferred from AWS's public Bedrock pricing page and model-id documentation, not from a real CUR or offer file. `act spike-aws` lists the real usage types and which ones still fail; anything that fails lands in the unmapped-meter admin queue. Marketplace-billed third-party rows whose usage type names no model ('MP:USE1_InputTokenCount-Units') do not parse by design.
_region_prefix_comment: CUR / price list usage types start with an AWS billing region code: USE1-, USW2-, EUC1-, EU-, APN1-, CAN1-, UGW1-, ... 'AI21-' is a vendor, not a region.
_model_id_comment: Cross-region inference profile prefixes and Bedrock model providers, stripped from ModelIds ('us.anthropic.claude-...'). Providers also appear glued to usage-type names ('AmazonNovaPro', 'AI21Jamba1.5Large'): 'compact_provider_prefixes' are tried off the front of a compact name when the whole name is unknown. 'mistral' and 'deepseek' are not in that list because their model names start with them.
_model_id_rewrites_comment: Applied in order to the lowercased last path segment of a ModelId / ARN after geo and provider prefixes are removed. ':0', ':0:200k', ':2' (version / context-window suffixes) go; '-v1' and '-v0' go; '-v2' and later stay, because they name a different model (claude-3-5-sonnet-v2, titan-embed-text-v2, embed-english-v3); 8-digit release dates go; OpenAI's '-1:0' style version goes.
_optional_suffixes_comment: Trailing words a usage type may leave out ('Llama3.1-70B' for llama3-1-70b-instruct). Registered as aliases automatically.
_models_comment: Canonical name -> extra spellings. The compact form of the canonical name (and of each alias) is matched, so 'Claude3.7Sonnet', 'claude-3-7-sonnet' and 'Claude-3-7-Sonnet' are one entry; aliases list only spellings whose compact form differs. Names follow the ModelId (provider, geo, date and version dropped). family_default names a family_defaults entry.
_family_defaults_comment: When a usage type names no direction: embeddings bill input tokens; image and video generators bill per image / second ('tokens': false: the price sync never stores tokens_per_unit for them, so estimates skip them); rerank bills per search unit.
_phrase_rewrites_comment: Regex substitutions on the lowercased, region-stripped usage type before tokenising: multi-word qualifiers become one token. Cache / long-context first, so 'cache-read-input-tokens' is not read as plain input.
_deployment_comment: On-demand and cross-region (geo / global inference profile) usage stay 'global', the type estimate.deployment_type gives a Bedrock deployment with no SKU. Latency-optimized / priority / flex tiers get their own type so their rates never become the estimator's base rate.
_modality_comment: Only tokens after the model name count, so 'image' in 'TitanImageGenerator' is not a modality.
